description: Rep. Pam Marsh, joined by a group of public officials and transit advocates, rode the bus from Ashland to Medford on Tuesday in support of a public transportation levy on May’s upcoming ballot. Measure 14-240 would continue providing local funding for Rogue Valley Public Transportation (RVTD) over for the next five years.
title: Rep. Pam Marsh catches the bus to show support for public transit funding - REPRESENTATIVE PAM MARSH
